title: One Piece Card Game Starter Decks: Every Deck and Which to Start With
summary: There are now 38 One Piece Card Game starter decks, from ST-01 Straw Hat Crew in 2022 to two Alabasta decks landing December 18, 2026. Here's what a starter deck is, every deck in order, and the best place to begin today.
description: Every One Piece Card Game starter deck from ST-01 to ST-38 with US release dates and MSRPs, plus which One Piece starter deck to start with in 2026.
source: ONE PIECE CARD GAME (official), product pages and Development Team letter, January 9, 2026. Prices are US MSRPs; store prices vary.
